title: Survey Response Bar Chart
subject: Economics
topic: Percentage of respondents with new routines
caption: Bar chart showing the percentage of survey respondents who have settled into new routines versus other response categories.
altText: A textbook‑style vertical bar chart on a white background displaying four response categories from a survey about new routines. The blue bar for "New routines" reaches 65% and is the tallest; the green bar for "Still adjusting" reaches 20%; the red bar for "No change" reaches 10%; and the gray bar for "Prefer not to say" reaches 5%. The horizontal axis lists the categories, and the vertical axis shows percentages from 0 to 100. Each bar is labeled with its exact percentage value above it, and a legend matches colors to categories.
